info.title: HawkerHubSG API
info.description: REST API for the Singapore Hawker Centre Management System. Customers browse stalls and place orders, vendors run their stall and its menu, hawker centre operators let their stalls to vendors, and NEA officers record hygiene inspections.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Register an account and sign in for a token

tags.name: Food Stalls
tags.description: Browsing stalls and menus, open to everyone

tags.name: Vendor Menu Management
tags.description: A vendor manages the stall assigned to their account

tags.name: Rental Agreements
tags.description: The tenancy of a stall between an operator and a vendor

tags.name: Tenancy Offers
tags.description: Terms the operator puts to a vendor, which only the vendor can sign

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: The inbox of the signed in account

tags.name: Review Replies
tags.description: A vendor's public answer to a customer review

tags.name: Order History
tags.description: Past and active orders of a customer

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Customer reviews of a food stall

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Sales figures for a vendor's own stall

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: JWT from POST /login. Enter it as: Bearer <your token>
